gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.description: Welcome to Kaimono! Let's get you set up and ready to organize your shopping like never before.

step1.title: Create Your Account
step1.description: Sign up using Google, GitHub, or email. It's quick and secure - you'll be shopping smarter in minutes!

step2.title: Create Your First App
step2.description: Think of Apps as your shopping headquarters. Create one for each major context: 'Home Renovation', 'Office Setup', or 'Event Planning'.

step3.title: Explore Your Dashboard
step3.description: Your command center shows everything at a glance - quick stats, recent activity, and fast actions to add items.

coreFeatures.title: Core Features
coreFeatures.description: Discover powerful tools that make Kaimono perfect for project-based purchasing.

essentials.title: Essentials - Your Regular Shopping List
essentials.description: Essentials are your go-to items - things you buy regularly like groceries, household supplies, or office materials.

quickAdd.title: Quick Add
quickAdd.description: Add items instantly with title, price, and quantity. Perfect for rapid grocery runs.

statusTracking.title: Status Tracking
statusTracking.description: Mark items as Pending, Purchased, or Cancelled to keep track of what's done.

planned.title: Planned Items - Future Purchases
planned.description: Plan ahead with detailed items that include priorities, images, descriptions, and can be organized into projects.

priorityLevels.title: Priority Levels
priorityLevels.description: Set LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, or URGENT priorities to focus on what matters most.

richDetails.title: Rich Details
richDetails.description: Add images, product URLs, descriptions, and quantity for complete purchase planning.

projects.title: Projects - Organize by Mission
projects.description: This is where Kaimono shines! Projects group related planned items together, perfect for complex purchasing missions.

kanbanBoard.title: Kanban Board View
kanbanBoard.description: Drag and drop planned items between stages. Visual workflow management at its best.

projectBased.title: Project-Based Organization
projectBased.description: Keep related purchases together. Perfect for renovations, events, or business setups.
projectBased.example: Home Office Setup: Desk, Chair, Monitor, Lamp

collaboration.title: Team Collaboration
collaboration.description: Work together seamlessly with your team, family, or project partners.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Complete control. Can manage apps, invite users, and handle all administrative tasks.

admin.title: Admin
admin.description: Can invite users and manage most features. Perfect for team leads and managers.

member.title: Member
member.description: Full access to add and edit items. Ideal for contributors and team members.

inviteStep.title: Invite Team Members
inviteStep.description: Send email invitations directly from the app. Assign roles and let your team join the shopping mission.

collaborateStep.title: Collaborate in Real-Time
collaborateStep.description: See updates instantly, comment on planned items, and like purchases. Everyone stays in sync.

proTips.title: Pro Tips & Best Practices
proTips.description: Level up your project-based purchasing with these expert strategies.

projectNaming.title: Project Naming Strategy
projectNaming.description: Use clear, actionable names. Include dates or phases for better organization.

priorityManagement.title: Priority Management
priorityManagement.description: Use URGENT for time-sensitive items, HIGH for important but flexible purchases.

teamCommunication.title: Team Communication
teamCommunication.description: Use comments on planned items to discuss options, alternatives, and decisions.
teamCommunication.example: Comment: Found this alternative on sale - thoughts?

regularReviews.title: Regular Reviews
regularReviews.description: Weekly reviews of planned items help prioritize and adjust timelines.
regularReviews.example: Friday review: Move 3 items to purchased, 2 to next week

cta.title: Ready to Start Your First Project?
cta.description: You've got the knowledge, now it's time to put it into practice. Create your first app and experience the power of project-based purchasing.
